findings.governing: comprehension principle; AUDIT_BRIEF §5 Function (copy change altering behavior); ANTAEUS_FINAL_AUDIT_CONTROL_PACKET_2026-11-16/antaeus-audit-control/01_OWNER_REQUIREMENTS.md (no regressions)
findings.proposed: Stop matching display text. Add a stable factor list to RecoveryAssessment in lib/recovery.ts (e.g. `factors: ReadonlyArray<'inactive'|'next-step-missing'|'next-step-undated'|'next-step-overdue'|'next-step-due'|'close-overdue'|'close-this-quarter'>`) set alongside each cause, and make applyFilter test factors: stalled = factors.includes('inactive'); this-quarter = factors includes 'close-this-quarter' or 'close-overdue'. Render: lane==='healthy' ? 'Lower risk' : isTop ? 'Highest-risk deal' : (lane==='critical' ? 'High risk' : 'Elevated risk'); append ' · largest value' only when isLargest.
